While I was playing with the children.
Discreetly, of course...

So it really
was you...
So I was
right after all...
Ishlar...!?
Ishlar...!
Hehe. What's with
those looks on your faces?
●.
You really are a fool.
You really are a fool.
You suspected me,
yet you went on naively
about trusting me.
Ahahahahaha...
And look where that got you!
...!
You never doubt
your own companions.
That's why you slipped up like this.
Of course, thanks to that,
I was able to prepare everything
perfectly for this moment.
You mean you've been
working according to a plan
from the very beginning...!?
Y-you coward!
I was simply
cleverer than you.
See?
I've even made
preparations like these.
Nooooo!
H-help us!
You would harm
the people of our settlement!?
Despicable...
I'll use any means
to achieve my objective.
What matters is exploiting
the enemy's weaknesses to win
as quickly and surely as possible.
Isn't that right, sister?
...
Sister...?
Sister...?
Sister...?
Sister...?
You don't mean...!?
Ahahahahaha... Now you
understand why
I did all this, don't you?
That's right. My name is
Ishlar Levinos, an operative
of Imperial Army Intelligence...
and Azlier's younger brother!
What did you say...?
No...
You...
You were in on it together
from the start!?
...!
Ahahaha! Someone like my sister,
always worried about appearances,
could never pull this off.
She's a soft touch,
just like you lot.
Using Intelligence's authority,
I asked only him to cooperate
and carried out the plan.
I never imagined you
had been in contact with Vijue,
Ishlar...
